influences.name: Rick Rubin
influences.context: "Without Rick's push, you know, for the counterintuitive sensitive guy song, we might have never had a chance to write that."

influences.name: Aaron Funk
influences.context: Frusciante felt that before any of them left the planet, he wanted to enjoy a sense of collaboration and exchange of ideas that he had only recently come to appreciate, mainly through his work with friend Aaron Funk on several electronic projects.

influences.name: Jimi Hendrix
influences.context: The first verse borrows heavily from the Jimi Hendrix rulebook – with its generous helping of G shape CAGED ideas, mini melodies inside certain chords and his thumb fretting root notes in places.
